agentic_repository_design.target_operator: Autonomous AI Agent & Human Peer Programmers
agentic_repository_design.philosophy: Agentic Repository Design: Purpose-built for autonomous CLI agents to engineer, audit, linter-enforce, and dual-commit software securely.

localonly_pattern.description: Any file containing local configs, secrets, private keys, or staging logs must append .localonly before its extension (e.g. config.localonly.js, wallet.localonly.json).
localonly_pattern.linter_rule: The pre-commit scanner blocks commits if secrets are found in non-.localonly files.

dual_git_metadata_routing.cli_routing: Commands route via --git-dir=.git_github --work-tree=. or env vars GIT_DIR / GIT_WORK_TREE.
